topic: Food Chains, Food Webs, and Energy Flow
key_concepts: Producers make their own food using energy from the sun
Tertiary and quaternary consumers occupy higher feeding levels
Decomposers break down dead organisms in food chains and food webs
A food chain shows a single path of energy transfer among organisms
A food web is made up of multiple interconnected food chains
Energy flows from the sun to producers and then to consumers
Energy is used by organisms for life processes and some is lost as heat
Human activities can impact ocean and forest food chains
Philippine forest ecosystems have biodiversity that needs conservation
Arrows in food chains and food webs show the direction of energy flow
